headline: Name SI plainly where people search for it, and lock in the offline recovery fix.

items.title: Expand SI on first use on /ai-vs-si/ and the Desk explainer, and gate future Desk copy
items.insight: Searchers and AI engines see which SI the page means in its title. Future Desk headlines cannot reopen the gap.

items.title: Durable real-browser origin-down regression for the offline recovery path
items.insight: A return of the offline reload loop now fails CI. Visitors keep a stable fallback while the origin is down.
